Ship-chain hot-reloads make restarts frequent, so any factory relying on cron delivery is exposed.

vpn/services/gatus/config/config.yaml carries live credentials in plaintext, including SSH private-key blocks. Never grep it with a context flag (-A/-B), and never print a parsed form of it - json.dumps of a single endpoint dict renders the key field verbatim. Read the KEY NAMES only; to compare a value, hash it in place. The read discipline is necessary but not sufficient: the PRINT is the second chokepoint, and it is the one that fails when the read felt safe. A third chokepoint is any TOOL whose output path renders the file's content: a diff, a checksum-and-dump, or a guard that prints a drift diff between two key-bearing copies discloses both. Read the output path before you ship the tool, not after.

announcements.text: The two board/ledger agreement gates are RETIRED, not red. tests/test_close_board_recorded.py and tests/test_board_intake_recorded.py assert a board/ledger close agreement, and this factory's issue board IS its ledger — ONE surface — so the two-surface predicate is INAPPLICABLE rather than failed. They were declared RED BY DESIGN at ledger n=611 and were the only REDs in the 23-gate audit. As of 2026-10-19 they are retired through the KIT'S DECLARED-ABSENT STATE, never by deletion: each reads the declared boundary from docs/ledger-invariants.json, this tree declares none, so each prints a named SKIP ('no docs/ledger-invariants.json — the boundary is a DECLARED factory parameter (#78 clause b)') and STILL RUNS EVERY PROBE — 11 on the close gate, 15 on the intake gate. HOW TO READ THEM NOW: a SKIP is the expected, correct state and is NOT a regression; but a RED from either gate IS a real defect — the retire was built so it cannot disguise a removed or broken gate. The four judgement probes are hermetic (a synthetic tree), and each gate keeps a positive control: a DECLARED boundary must still fail a bad row. The old 'RED BY DESIGN, do not file as a regression' instruction is WITHDRAWN — filing one of these as a regression is now the wrong call only if it SKIPPED; if it FAILED, file it. Owner directive 2026-10-19: 'i don't want to be asked such low level questions any more' — q27 is answered and the class (kit convention, internal mechanics) is now HQ's to decide, never the owner register's.
